functions.name: writeRgbaPixel
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (param $p5 i32) (param $p6 i32) (param $p7 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Mode 1 blends all four source bytes with alpha^255; modes 2/4 preserve the high byte; other modes copy RGBA.

validation.comparison: Every case checks the result and the written RGBA word. 8 cases compare all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Coverage includes modes -1..8, five source words, four colour triples with wrapped operands, alpha variants, six coordinates and boundary traps.
limitations: Callers own surface descriptors and pixel addresses.
Mode 1 high-byte additions and shifts intentionally wrap as i32.
Mode 2/4 preserve the original high byte without blending it.
Ledger: 342 client bodies recovered and 3,903 remain machine code.
